races.rationale: Sunlight held within the body and canopy-centered communities connect them to sacred light and the open sky.
Radiance-metabolizing lineages interpret sacred light and visible vows through Sokhivar’s prophetic sky symbolism.
Music, performance, and freedom in open-air courts connect many Gandirosha traditions to Sokhivar.
Air, magical light, and sky-facing aether traditions place part of Panolima worship under Sokhivar.
Bioluminescent display and resonant communication give Sokhivar a secondary role in music-and-light observances.
Late-life functional wings are interpreted through sky, freedom, and prophetic ascent symbolism.
Flight, feathers, migration, public coordination, and sky symbolism connect them to Sokhivar.
Sky travel, layered song, and safe wind corridors directly match sunlight, music, prophecy, and divine freedom.
Despite their nocturnal habits, their avian bodies and aerial culture preserve an inherited association with the sky.
Solar feathers, migration, high-altitude travel, and visible civic crests directly reflect Sokhivar’s domains.
Probable futures are interpreted through prophecy while remaining choices rather than fixed commands.
